key.name: taskbar-position
key.description: Sets the screen edge for the taskbar. Allowed values are 'bottom' and 'top'.

key.name: taskbar-alignment
key.description: Sets the alignment of dock icons. Allowed values are 'center' and 'left'.

key.name: taskbar-height
key.description: Sets the height of the taskbar in pixels.

key.name: icon-size
key.description: Sets the size of dock application icons in pixels.

key.name: pinned-apps
key.description: Stores the list of desktop file identifiers for pinned applications.

key.name: show-running-apps
key.description: Controls whether unpinned active applications appear on the dock.

key.name: clock-format
key.description: Specifies the GLib date and time format string for the taskbar clock.

key.name: theme-palette
key.description: Sets the active color palette. Allowed values: 'nord', 'win11-blue', 'mica-dark', 'aurora', 'cyberpunk'.

key.name: acrylic-opacity
key.description: Sets the opacity fraction for taskbar and flyout acrylic surfaces.

key.name: corner-radius
key.description: Sets the border radius in pixels for flyout menus and windows.

key.name: flyout-margin
key.description: Sets the distance in pixels between the taskbar edge and flyout menus.

key.name: start-menu-width
key.description: Sets the horizontal width in pixels of the Start Menu flyout.

key.name: start-menu-height
key.description: Sets the vertical height in pixels of the Start Menu flyout.

key.name: show-recommended-files
key.description: Controls whether recent files appear inside the Start Menu.

key.name: max-recommended-files
key.description: Sets the maximum count of recent files shown in the Start Menu.

key.name: enable-calculator
key.description: Controls whether mathematical expressions evaluate inside the search box.

key.name: enable-snap-layouts
key.description: Controls whether the window tiling snap layouts menu is enabled.
